title: Bezalel, Oholiab, and the Sabbath

questions.question: Who did God choose by name to lead the construction of the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:2 (ESV): "I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah."

questions.question: Who was appointed to assist Bezalel?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6 (ESV): "I have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan."

questions.question: What did God fill Bezalel with?
options: The Spirit of God, with ability and intelligence
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit of God, with ability and intelligence
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:3 (ESV): "I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with ability and intelligence, with knowledge and all craftsmanship."

questions.question: What did God give Moses at the end of speaking on Mount Sinai?
options: Two tablets of testimony, written with the finger of God
questions.correctAnswer: Two tablets of testimony, written with the finger of God
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:18 (ESV): "He gave to Moses... the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God."

questions.question: What commandment did God emphasize in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:13 (ESV): "Above all you shall keep my Sabbaths."

questions.question: What was the Sabbath described as between God and Israel?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:17 (ESV): "It is a sign forever between me and the people of Israel."

questions.question: What was the penalty for profaning the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:14 (ESV): "Everyone who profanes it shall be put to death."

questions.question: From which tribe was Bezalel?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:2 (ESV): "Bezalel the son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah."

questions.question: From which tribe was Oholiab?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:6 (ESV): "Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan."

questions.question: What materials was Bezalel skilled in working with?
options: Gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:4-5 (ESV): "To devise artistic designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze, in cutting stones... and in carving wood."

questions.question: What would happen to someone who worked on the Sabbath?
options: Cut off from among his people
questions.correctAnswer: Cut off from among his people
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:14 (ESV): "Whoever does any work on it, that soul shall be cut off from among his people."

questions.question: Why did God rest on the seventh day according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:17 (ESV): "In six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested and was refreshed."

questions.question: What material were the tablets of testimony made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:18 (ESV): "The two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone."

questions.question: Who wrote on the tablets of testimony?
options: God (written with the finger of God)
questions.correctAnswer: God (written with the finger of God)
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:18 (ESV): "Tablets of stone, written with the finger of God."

questions.question: What is the Sabbath called in this chapter?
options: A Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: A Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the Lord
questions.explanation: Exodus 31:15 (ESV): "But the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the Lord."

key_verse_text: And he gave to Moses, when he had finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God.
